purpose: frozen cross-year hydraulic component test; no parameter retuning

confirmed_data_semantics.flow_sources: TD and SW are comparable sources; BHT is available from TD only
confirmed_data_semantics.bht_discharge: instantaneous Beijing-time inflow at segment 2; dam release only
confirmed_data_semantics.water_level_datum: BHT, SJ, YMT and other stations may be treated as one datum
confirmed_data_semantics.time_alignment: instantaneous Beijing time; discharge and stage treated as synchronous
confirmed_data_semantics.distributed_flow: historical virtual water-level correction; not physical observed inflow
confirmed_data_semantics.internal_branch_junctions: none in segments 2-27; BR2 joins at segment 28
confirmed_data_semantics.missing_station_data: exclude missing periods rather than fabricate values
confirmed_data_semantics.closing_timestamp: 2026-01-01 00:00 is excluded from the 2025 analysis period

boundary_mapping.method: linear interpolation between SJ segment 26 and YMT segment 57

limitations: This is a quasi-steady component test, not a complete 2020-2025 CE-QUAL-W2 simulation.
Full-model runs require complete meteorology, temperature, tributary and operating boundary inputs.
The downstream segment-28 stage is spatially interpolated from SJ and YMT observations.
One-hour internal BHT discharge gaps are linearly interpolated and separately labelled.
The component test omits the historical virtual distributed-flow correction.
Storage derivatives are centered finite differences; 2/6/12/24-hour windows quantify derivative sensitivity.
